name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Bercy Village
tagline: 139 apartments in Bercy Village, from 20 m² studios to a 112 m² four-bedroom co-living flat.
description:
The Aparthotel Adagio Original Paris Bercy is situated in the eastern part of Paris, at the heart of the Bercy Village quarter, close to the restaurants and shops that line the Cour Saint-Emilion. The aparthotel comprises of 140 fully equipped flats. Guests can use a launderette, ironing service. The complex also has a meeting room available to business travellers. Our reception staff are on hand 24 hours a day.

Discover a new concept at the aparthotel Adagio Original Paris Bercy!

4 bedrooms connected to a common living area with a fully equipped kitchen, the Coliving apartment can host up to 8 persons, for mid- and longstay. These apartments were designed for yourself, your family, group of friends or work colleagues.

Location

Our Adagio Original Paris Bercy hotel is located in the immediate vicinity of the Gare de Lyon and the banks of the Seine. You can choose to take a walk or have a drink on the banks of the Seine, or use line 14 to get around Paris. Passing through Châtelet and the Saint-Lazare station, you can get to the centre of Paris or to the department stores in a few minutes.

Choosing your hotel in Bercy village

By choosing an Adagio aparthotel in Bercy Village, you are sure to be well located to move around Paris, or to enjoy the different places near your accommodation. Moreover, all our aparthotels are equipped with everything you need for your comfort, the kitchen and the bathroom are equipped to ensure an ideal stay.

Adagio Paris Bercy Village immerses you in the energy of a unique neighborhood, near the metro and iconic sites. Enjoy Paris in a vibrant atmosphere - your starting point for wonderful discoveries.

Aude BULLY, Hotel Manager

In the heart of Bercy Village and the dynamic East Parisian business district, Adagio Paris Bercy Village offers 139 apartments from 2 person studios to two room, four person apartments. Located a few steps from the Parc de Bercy and the quays of the Seine, the Aparthotel has very easy, 5 minute access to the Gare de Lyon, and 10 min access to the center of Paris by metro line 14. It has a seminar room that hosts up to 20 people.

description:

Rated a 4-star tourist residence, our 76 apartments are suitable for all types of stay. The apparthotel has no apartments for disabled guests, nor air conditioning.

An interior garden, cut off from the outside, is accessible from reception, ideal for taking a short reading break in the Parisian sunshine. Covered private parking is also available (subject to availability).

Pets are welcome.

Should you need assistance, our reception team is available 24 hours a day.

The Adagio Paris Montmartre aparthotel is near Sacre Coeur in Montmartre, an area that is packed with 20th-century Parisian charm as depicted by artists like Manet, Toulouse-Lautrec and Picasso. Our 76 apartments are suitable for all types of stay. However, the apartments do not have AC and are not adapted for PRM. An indoor garden is available via reception, so you can enjoy some open-air reading.

The aparthotel does not have flats suitable for disabled guests or air conditioning.

name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Montrouge
tagline: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Montrouge offers studios and apartments within a hotel featuring a quiet garden setting, located just 2.5 km from the Porte de Versailles exhibition…
description:
Aparthotel Adagio Paris Montrouge offers studios and apartments within a hotel featuring a quiet garden setting, located just 2.5 km from the Porte de Versailles exhibition center and close to public transport.

You will enjoy a private apartment within the Montrouge hotel, featuring a comfortable bedroom, a workspace area, a living room, a private bathroom, and a fully equipped kitchen, along with free Wi-Fi. Guests can also take advantage of a breakfast buffet and a 24-hour reception, as well as private on-site parking—all just 1 km from Paris.

A modern aparthotel in Montrouge, just steps from Paris

Aparthotel Adagio Paris Montrouge is a 15-minute drive from Paris-Orly Airport. This 4-star hotel offers 132 apartments, perfectly suited for both family vacations and business trips.

A fully equipped kitchen is at your disposal (ceramic cooktop, extractor hood, dishwasher, microwave, refrigerator, kettle, coffee maker, and kitchenware).

Your apartment features an air-cooling system and a private bathroom equipped with a bathtub, a heated towel rail, and a hairdryer to ensure your stay in Montrouge is as comfortable as possible.

As with all Aparthotel Adagio locations in France, you have free access to all our services during your stay at our Montrouge hotel, including:

A self-service library of items (accessories, books, games);
A breakfast buffet served every morning;
Laundry and dry-cleaning services for your clothes and outfits;
Private parking for easy parking in Montrouge. Aparthotel Adagio Paris Montrouge also offers the following amenities:
A kids' corner with games to keep your children entertained;
An on-site tennis court for you to use during your stay.

A hotel near the Salon de Montrouge and Paris Montparnasse

Montrouge is a town renowned for its cultural exhibitions and numerous art galleries. You will be staying in an aparthotel located just steps away from the Salon de Montrouge, a famous contemporary art exhibition.

While staying at our aparthotel in Montrouge, take the opportunity to visit the Montparnasse Tower for a panoramic view of Paris, then head to the Montparnasse Cemetery, the final resting place of many notable figures.

To get some fresh air and relax after a day of sightseeing in the Île-de-France region, take a stroll through the Parc des Écrivains Combattants in Montrouge or visit Parc Montsouris, located on the edge of Paris's 14th arrondissement.

Welcome to the Aparthotel Adagio Paris Montrouge. We are delighted to welcome you and wish you a pleasant stay, combining comfort, autonomy and proximity to the heart of Paris.

Stephan VOS, Hotel Manager

Ideal for a stay in Paris, the Adagio Paris Montrouge enjoys a convenient location, well served by public transport, near shopping streets. Situated just 1.6 miles (2.5 km) from Porte de Versailles Exhibition Center, this 4-star aparthotel offers 132 contemporary and practical studios and one-bedroom apartments with an air cooling system. The aparthotel is 15 minutes from Orly Airport and offers parking.

name: Aparthotel Adagio Paris Boulogne
tagline: The Adagio Original Paris Boulogne aparthotel is ideally located near the Boulogne Billancourt metro station (line 9), as well as many of the Hauts-de Seine's local…
description:
The Adagio Original Paris Boulogne aparthotel is ideally located near the Boulogne Billancourt metro station (line 9), as well as many of the Hauts-de Seine's local attractions: the futuristic Seine Musicale concert hall on the Ile Seguin, the La Défense business district, Roland Garros for tennis tournaments and the Parc des Princes, the legendary stadium of Paris Saint Germain. Numerous markets and grocery stores, as well as bars and restaurants, are located close to the hotel, making it easy for you to do your shopping or go out for dinner.
Our aparthotel is close to the magnificent Domaine National de St-Cloud, where you can relax or discover the Manufacture de Sèvres.
If you need to get around, Paris line 9 will take you from east to west, passing through some of the city's most famous landmarks: the Trocadero, the Champs-Elysées and the department store district.

The services of our aparthotel in Boulogne
Our hotel offers a wide range of services to make your stay in Boulogne a moment of calm and serenity. Whether for one night or several months, put your luggage down in a spacious, comfortable and fully-equipped apartment. Your independence is our priority: a kitchen, office area, ample storage space and Wi-Fi connection are all at your disposal. To help you travel light, we also offer a laundry and dry-cleaning service. Convenience guaranteed!
Open all year round, we look forward to welcoming you to Boulogne. If you're coming by car, you can take advantage of our private parking with charging stations for electric vehicles. Then, after a day of discoveries or business meetings, you'll want to take some time for yourself. Our fully-equipped fitness room awaits you, to revitalize you or simply to relax.
At Adagio Paris Boulogne, everyone feels at home, including your four-legged friends, with a sliding scale of charges from the 4th night of your stay.
Please note that apartments adapted for people with reduced mobility are available in our aparthotel.
Make yourself at home with us, in the heart of the Hauts-de-Seine, and enjoy a stay that's just like you.

Treat yourself to a unique experience in a new aparthotel on the outskirts of Paris, near high-profile cultural and sporting events, with amenities designed to simplify your stay.

Lucille Scellier, Hotel Manager

The Adagio Paris Boulogne aparthotel is in southwest Paris and a 10-min walk from La Seine Musicale, 2 metro stops from Parc des Princes and a 10-min drive from Roland Garros and Porte de Versailles Convention Center. We have 101 spacious apartments-from 1-person studios to 2-room apartments for 4 people-that are equipped and furnished. There is also a fitness center, laundry facilities and private parking.

Ideally located just a few minutes from the Palais des Congrès and La Défense in western Paris, the Adagio Paris Suresnes Longchamp apartment hotel is the perfect place to stay when visiting the city, no matter how short or long your stop. The hotel has 109 apartments to offer in total, consisting of 89 two-person apartments (including seven equipped with balconies) and 20 four-person apartments (including six with balconies). name: Aparthotel Adagio La Defense Kleber
tagline: Located in the La Défense business district (Courbevoie), just 2 minutes' walk from the Business Centre, close to La Défense Arena and less than 13 minutes from the…
description:
Located in the La Défense business district (Courbevoie), just 2 minutes' walk from the Business Centre, close to La Défense Arena and less than 13 minutes from the Champs-Élysées, Aparthotel Adagio La Défense Kléber offers 55 welcoming, fully furnished apartments with terrace or balcony.

The property benefits from an ideal location near the CNIT, the Westfield Les 4 Temps shopping centre and numerous shops and services. La Défense Arena is also accessible in just 15 minutes on foot.

The aparthotel La Défense Kléber offers a dry-cleaning service, as well as a private covered parking (at an additional cost). Our reception team is available 24/7 to meet your needs, and an excursion desk is at your service to help organise your stay.

A bright and fully equipped aparthotel at La Défense Kléber

Our aparthotel at La Défense Kléber offers everything you need for a comfortable stay, just a stone's throw from Paris. In the heart of La Défense, you have an entire home to yourself, made even better with hotel services. Ideal for a family stay or a business trip, the La Défense business district and all of Paris's iconic attractions and landmarks are easily accessible on foot, by bike or by metro.

Adagio La Défense Kléber: tailored accommodation for all your needs

Our aparthotel at La Défense Kléber offers a full range of accommodation to suit your needs: elegant studios for two and spacious apartments sleeping up to six guests.

Designed to make life easier for business travellers, all units include a desk and a dining area fully equipped to prepare and enjoy your meals independently. The kitchen is fully fitted with a refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, Nespresso coffee machine, kettle, crockery and utensils.
At Adagio, your comfort is our priority: each apartment features a private bathroom with hairdryer, accessible to people with reduced mobility, as well as cable/satellite TV, air conditioning, fast Wi-Fi and a safe for your laptop.
Enjoy practical services designed to make your stay at La Défense Kléber as easy as possible: a laundry and dry-cleaning service takes care of your clothes, while an electric vehicle charging point is available on site. Every morning, start the day with a delicious hot breakfast buffet. Parking (at an additional cost) is also available, and our reception team is on hand 24/7 to meet your every need.

Finally, for those wishing to extend their stay, our sliding-scale rates allow you to enjoy all our benefits at an even more attractive price across all our Adagio aparthotels in France.

A hotel close to Boulogne-Billancourt at La Défense Kléber

Just a few kilometres from our aparthotel at La Défense Kléber, you can easily reach the Bois de Boulogne and its vast park. The Jardin d'Acclimatation and rowing boats are available to enjoy the lake — a must-see in the heart of Île-de-France.

You can also visit Mont-Valérien in Suresnes for a breathtaking view over Paris and discover the monument erected in tribute to the French Resistance, known as the Mémorial de la France Combattante. Don't miss the nearby American Cemetery, a deeply moving memorial site with remarkable views over Paris.

If you are a music lover, head to La Seine Musicale in Boulogne-Billancourt, just 15 minutes from La Défense. Come and enjoy concerts and shows featuring contemporary dance or classical music. The Île Séguin, on which this cultural venue was built, also offers a pleasant stroll in a peaceful setting.

At the Adagio La Défense Kléber, we open our doors to you with a smile so that every moment of your stay is a pleasure.

Henri RABOT, Hotel Manager

description:
The Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Pont D'Ivry aparthotel welcomes you to a modern setting in the heart of the Ivry Confluence district, on the border of Paris’s 13th arrondissement. Nearby, you’ll find several key business hubs, including Paris Bercy, the François-Mitterrand Library, and Paris Expo.

Make the most of your time in the capital by strolling along the Seine, visiting museums and soaking up Parisian life, all while staying in a hotel in Ivry-sur-Seine, close to Gare de Lyon and right at the gateway to Paris.

The advantages of staying in an aparthotel in Ivry-sur-Seine

Each studio and apartment at the Aparthotel Paris Pont d’Ivry aparthotel comes with all the amenities our guests appreciate:

Fully equipped kitchen
Dedicated workspace
Air conditioning and high-speed Wi-Fi
Fitness room, bar, and paid private parking
Laundry facilities and 24-hour reception
Meeting rooms (if your visit is work-related)

This accommodation near Paris’s 13th arrondissement is ideal for business travellers working in South-East Paris or Bercy, as well as tourists seeking a self-catering, comfortable base for a night, a week, or an extended stay.

A well-located aparthotel close to everything

Our aparthotel in Ivry-sur-Seine is located in a fast-developing neighbourhood, perfectly positioned for easy travel around Paris:

Close to the RER C (Ivry-sur-Seine) and Metro line 7, connecting directly to Bercy, Tolbiac, Gare de Lyon, and central Paris in just minutes,
Direct access to Orly Airport via the A86 motorway (fast links to Paris Expo),
Within reach of a wide range of cultural and leisure activities in Val-de-Marne : strolls along the Seine, the MAC VAL Museum in Vitry-sur-Seine, Théâtre des Quartiers d’Ivry, and Manufacture des Œillets,
Next to the Quai d’Ivry shopping centre, with bars and restaurants if you prefer to dine out instead of using your in-room kitchen.

The Aparthotel Adagio Access Paris Pont D'Ivry in the Île-de-France region offers modern accommodation and quality hotel services designed for your comfort during your travel in Paris for business or as a tourist.

On the outskirts of Paris in the Ivry Confluence district, the Adagio Access Paris Pont d'Ivry offers the comfort of an aparthotel that feels just like home, featuring all the amenities needed for a successful stay. From the 24-hour reception and 60 Scandinavian-style apartments to the bar and interior patio, the Adagio Access Paris Pont d'Ivry is designed as a large home where everyone feels welcome.

Adagio Access Massy Palaiseau is located near the Paris-Saclay campus. It welcomes travellers who wish to maintain their independence without compromising on comfort. This 2-star aparthotel in Massy Palaiseau is therefore ideal for business travellers, students on the move or extended stays near the capital.

Services and facilities in your aparthotel in Massy

The residence offers spacious, bright studios and apartments. They are equipped with:

a kitchenette with fridge, microwave, hob, kettle and crockery,
a private bathroom with household linen,
a living area with a flat-screen TV and desk,
a balcony or terrace (in some units),
and high-speed Wi-Fi.

air conditioning,
laundry facilities,
buffet breakfast,
secure underground parking on reservation,
accessibility for disabled guests,
24-hour reception,
luggage storage,
and an 80 m² meeting room for hosting business events and meetings.

A well-located aparthotel in Massy Palaiseau, close to Paris

The Massy district is connected to Paris (30 minutes) thanks to the RER B at Palaiseau station, only 400 m from the hotel. What’s more, Massy TGV station is less than 2 km away and Orly Airport is 15 km away. If you are travelling by car, you can take the N118 or the A10.

Adagio Access Massy Palaiseau aparthotel also offers quick access to the Paris-Saclay campus, including École Polytechnique, CentraleSupélec, ENS Paris-Saclay, the CEA Saclay research centre and the Golf National.

This setting in Île-de-France combines residential tranquillity with major economic and innovation hubs, all surrounded by green spaces and soft-mobility routes such as the Palaiseau forest, the Coulée Verte and the Vallée de Chevreuse.

The aparthotel in Massy Palaiseau is also close to the Les Ulis 2 shopping centre, where you’ll find restaurants and local shops.

Come to Adagio Access in Essonne and enjoy a modern, comfortable and independent aparthotel with easy access. Guests and families can settle in for a night, a week or longer, and enjoy a setting designed for work, study or leisure. Book your apartment in Massy Palaiseau now for a stay in France that combines work, relaxation and freedom.

description:
The Aparthotel Adagio Access La Défense Puteaux is ideally located in the heart of La Défense business district, just 700 metres from Esplanade de La Défense metro station and a 10-minute drive from Paris La Défense Arena.

The aparthotel offers 115 fully furnished and equipped apartments, ranging from studios for one guest to one-bedroom apartments accommodating up to four guests. Guests also have access to a fitness room, laundry facilities and private parking.

Located in Puteaux, the aparthotel is only a 15-minute walk from Westfield Les 4 Temps , one of Europe's largest shopping centres. Whether you're travelling with friends or colleagues, you'll enjoy easy access to a wide selection of shops, restaurants, cafés and a cinema, all within easy reach of your aparthotel.

A comfortable aparthotel in Puteaux for your business stay

Whether you're visiting for business or leisure, our aparthotel in Puteaux, just outside Paris, offers a comfortable and fully equipped base in the heart of La Défense business district.

To make your business trip as convenient as possible, the aparthotel features a meeting room where you can welcome clients or hold meetings with colleagues.

Each apartment also includes a dedicated workspace and a dining area, allowing you to work comfortably and enjoy home-cooked meals prepared in your fully equipped kitchen, complete with a refrigerator, microwave, coffee machine and stovetop.

For added comfort, every apartment features a private bathroom, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV and high-speed Wi-Fi.

During your stay, you can also enjoy a range of Adagio services , including:

Laundry and dry-cleaning services;
A breakfast buffet (available at an additional cost);
Secure on-site paid parking;
A 24-hour reception desk.

Travelling with your pet? Good news: pets are welcome. If you're planning a longer stay, you'll also benefit from attractive discounted rates available for extended stays.

Stay in the heart of La Défense

During your stay in Puteaux, don't miss the Takis Basin , a captivating outdoor art installation that has become one of La Défense's most iconic landmarks.

Take advantage of your location to spend the day at Westfield Les 4 Temps , home to hundreds of shops, restaurants, cafés, a cinema and a variety of leisure activities, including karting and laser tag. It's the perfect destination for families, friends or colleagues exploring the Paris region.

From the aparthotel, you can also reach the Fondation Louis Vuitton in just 10 minutes by bike. Set in the beautiful Bois de Boulogne, it showcases world-class contemporary art exhibitions and is an unmissable cultural experience during your stay.

Adagio Access Puteaux is just a 5-minute walk from La Défense, near the Plenitude Arena (formerly La Défense Arena) and a 7-minute walk from metro line 1. Our reception desk is open 24/7 to ensure a pleasant stay.

FREDERIC MARTINELLI, Hotel Manager

Located in the heart of La Défense, close to the CNIT, Paris La Plenitude Arena (formerly Paris La Défense Arena) and Les Quatre Temps shopping centre, Adagio Access La Défense Puteaux has 115 fully equipped studios and apartments. The property features two meeting facilities, a car park, gym, and quick access to central Paris via public transport in just 15 minutes.

La Clef Champs-Élysées Paris by The Crest Collection, a 5-star hotel in the centre of Paris, offers you a unique stay in a typically Parisian atmosphere.
The building was built in 1907 by the Hennessy family, during the enchanting interlude offered by the Paris of the "Belle Époque".
Reflecting this magical era, our luxury hotel in Paris embodies a certain French art de vivre.
Stay in a 5 star hotel Paris overlooking the Champs-Elysées
Our luxury hotel Paris Champs-Élysées
Our 5-star hotel enjoys an idyllic setting and immerses you in the prestigious atmosphere of the area. Ideally located in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, you are a stone's throw away from the most beautiful avenue in the world: Avenue des Champs-Elysées, which stretches from Place de la Concorde to the Arc de Triomphe.
This ideal location also allows you to visit Paris and all its nooks and crannies. Indeed, you are only a few minutes away from the Trocadéro, the Grand Palais, the Louvre and the Tuileries Gardens, or the Eiffel Tower.
You are also just a 5-minute walk from Avenue Montaigne, the temple of French fashion and luxury, which is home to the great names in Haute Couture such as Chanel, Dior and Louis Vuitton.
Getting to our luxury hotel Champs-Elysées
Our 5-star hotel La Clef Champs-Élysées Paris by The Crest Collection opens the doors to a world of elegance and refinement in the heart of the City of Light.
The nearby metro stations are Georges V and Kléber, on metro lines 6 and 1.
From Paris airports:
From Orly, take the Orlybus to Denfert-Rochereau, then take metro line 6 to Kléber station.
From Roissy Charles de Gaulle airport, take the RER to Châtelet-Les Halles station, then take metro line 1 to George V station.
From Paris train stations:
From Gare du Nord and Gare de l'Est stations, take bus 43 to the Friedland Haussmann stop.
From Gare de l'Est, take bus 30 to the Charles de Gaulle-Étoile stop.
From Gare Montparnasse, take line 1 to George V, a 5-minute walk from our 5-star Paris hotel.
From Gare de Lyon station, take line 1 to George V, which is a 5-minute walk from the 5-star hotel.
Characteristics and facilities of our hotel Champs-Elysées
Types of apartments in our luxury hotel in Paris
Our apartments with terraces overlook the Golden Triangle district.
They offer an extraordinary view of the most beautiful monuments of the City of Light, including the Eiffel Tower.
Ranging from 23 to 56 m², our spacious rooms and apartments combine comfort and design, allowing you to make the most of your stay in the French capital, whether you are travelling for business or pleasure.
Among other things, you benefit from
:
A fully-equipped kitchen
A separate bathroom
A minibar
An LCD flat-screen TV with access to French and international channels and equipped with Chromecast
Free high speed WiFi
Air-conditioning

available on request
Visit Paris from our 5-star hotel Paris Champs-Élysées
The Grand Palais
Close to our hotel on the Champs-Elysées, the Grand Palais is only a few minutes walk away. Originating from the 1900 World's Fair, its roof, created through innovative work using glass and steel, is supported by a 250-metre colonnade. Many contemporary art exhibitions are held here, such as the FIAC.
Access in 15 minutes on foot from our luxury hotel Paris Champs-Élysées.
Le Marais
The trendy district of Le Marais has a village feel to it that makes it very endearing. Private mansions and princely palaces, modern art galleries, the Picasso and Carnavalet Museum, the marvellous Place des Vosges, or the park of the Square du Temple await you for timeless moments.
Access in 20 minutes by metro (line 1) from our 5-star hotel Paris Champs-Élysées.
Place de la Bastille
Here you will find the Bastille Opera House, once a prison and designed by the Canadian architect Carlos Ott. Stroll along the viaduct that runs parallel to the Avenue Daumesnil, which has been transformed into a planted promenade and is also home to some of the best examples of design and craftsmanship in Paris.
Access in 19 minutes by metro (line 1) from our luxury hotel Paris Champs-Élysées.
La Défense
Get to the La Défense district in a few minutes and discover the heart of international business in the City of Lights. Experiencing Paris under the arch or at the top is another adventure of your tourist stay.
Access in 14 minutes by metro (line 1) from our 5-star hotel Paris Champs-Élysées.
The Place de la Madeleine
It is on this square that the church of Madeleine rises with such a complex history: it was a church, a stock exchange, a bank of France, and it almost became a temple to the glory of Napoleon's soldiers and then a railway station! But it returned to its first purpose, a church, in 1845.
Access in 13 minutes by metro (line 1) from our luxury hotel Paris Champs-Élysées.
Montmartre
Don't hesitate to visit the Montmartre cemetery, or lose yourself in the lanes lined with vineyards as you head towards the Galette mill, the Bateau-Lavoir, or the Place des Abbesses and its Saint-Jean-de-Montmartre church built in reinforced concrete on a metal frame in 1904.
Access in 26 minutes by metro (line 2) from our 5-star hotel Paris Champs-Élysées.

La Clef Champs-Élysées Paris by The Crest Collection is a sublime 5-star hotel offering unparalleled luxury
With 63 elegant rooms and suites, as well as 7 apartments and duplexes, this hotel guarantees a relaxing stay in the heart of the French capital.
Generous spaces ranging from 23 to 56 m², noble materials such as parquet floors, moldings, and private fireplaces, as well as fully equipped kitchens and premium services (unlimited Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV with Chromecast, air conditioning, state-of-the-art security systems), ensure an exceptional experience.
Located in the 8th arrondissement, just steps away from the Avenue des Champs-Élysées and Place de l’Étoile, our rooms reflect the exceptional neighborhood you’ve chosen to stay in. Elegance harmoniously blends here with the beauty of the City of Light.
Whether for a business trip or a leisure stay, La Clef Champs-Élysées Paris by The Crest Collection offers an intimate and soothing setting, perfect for discovering the City of Light under the best conditions.

At the foot of the Palais du Louvre, our 5-star serviced residence in Paris guarantees you a unique stay in the capital.
Just a stone's throw from the Tuileries Gardens, the Arc de Triomphe and the Louvre Museum, you benefit from a prime location.

Stay in a 5-star serviced residence Paris Louvre
An ideal location close to the Louvre in Paris
La Clef Louvre Paris by The Crest Collection is ideally located in the 1st arrondissement, in the very centre of Paris. You are just a few minutes away from the Palais du Louvre Museum, the Comédie-Française, the Tuileries Gardens and the Opéra Garnier.
This unique area offers a wealth of high-end boutiques, trendy cafés and cultural attractions.
Easy access to our luxury serviced residence in Paris
La Clef Louvre Paris by The Crest Collection is just a 3-minute walk from the Palais-Royal Musée du Louvre Metro station, which is served by lines 1 and 7. These provide access to the entire Parisian network (metro, RER, tram and bus). You are therefore completely autonomous for your journeys in and around the French capital.
In particular, you are less than 12 minutes from the Gare de Lyon, Gare de l'Est and Gare Saint-Lazare. Gare du Nord and Gare d'Austerlitz can be reached in 20 minutes.
If you are travelling by plane, one hour by public transport will be enough to reach the serviced residence Louvre from Paris-CDG or Paris-Orly airport. Allow an additional 15 minutes for Paris-Le Bourget.
If you choose to take a taxi, allow 35 minutes if traffic is good.
Discover our luxury serviced residence Paris Louvre
Let yourself be seduced by our boutique serviced residence Louvre Paris. This 5-star luxury serviced residence in the centre of the capital is part of a unique complex of residences, The Crest Collection.
Our fully equipped apartments
It is in the heart of the historic district of Paris, in a magnificent Haussmann-style building, that our spacious, contemporary and elegant apartments welcome couples, families and friends.
Whether for a short or long stay, you will feel at home in our 4 categories of Apartments : First, Exclusive, Junior or Royal.
All our air-conditioned apartments are fully equipped:

flat screen TV with integrated Chromecast
kitchen with hob, microwave, dishwasher, Nespresso coffee machine, electric kettle, toaster, kitchen utensils and crockery

Visit the city from our luxury serviced residence Paris Louvre
The Champs-Élysées
Following the historical axis of the city for 2 kilometres, the Champs-Elysées form one of the most famous avenues in the world. Numerous luxury brands border it as well as numerous cinemas and restaurants. Take the time to stroll along with it without losing sight of the Arc de Triomphe.
It is 9 minutes away by metro (line 1) from our 5-star serviced residence in Paris.
Boulevard Haussmann
Boulevard Haussmann is one of the liveliest avenues in Paris. In these buildings with typical Parisian architecture, you will find the Grévin Museum and the department stores. The rooftops of Printemps and Galeries Lafayette offer a breathtaking view of the City of Light. If you come during the festive season, don't miss the magical world of their window displays.
Access in 7 minutes by metro (line 7) or bus (line 68) or 13 minutes on foot from our luxury serviced residence in Paris.
The Eiffel Tower
Located on the Champs de Mars, on the banks of the Seine, the most emblematic monument in Paris was built in 1889 for the Universal Exhibition. Rising to a height of 312 metres, it offers a panoramic view over the whole of Paris.
Access in 26 minutes by bus (line 72) 30 minutes by metro (lines 1 and 6) from our luxury serviced residence Paris Louvre.
Notre-Dame de Paris Cathedral
Notre-Dame de Paris, inaugurated in 1345, is a symbol of the Catholic Church from the 14th century to the present day. Its beauty and history have inspired many artists such as the writers’ Victor Hugo and Honoré de Balzac, the painter Jacques-Louis David or the singer Edith Piaf.
Access in 15 minutes by metro (line 1 or 7) from our Paris 5-star serviced residence Paris Louvre.
The Grand and Petit Palais
Designed for the Universal Exhibition of 1900, the Grand Palais presented an architectural revolution that combined glass and steel. Today its art exhibitions, such as the FIAC (International Contemporary Art Fair), bring together millions of people every year. Opposite, the Petit Palais, inaugurated the same year, is dedicated to the pictorial arts of the 19th century, which are in perfect harmony with the place.
Access in 9 minutes by metro (line 1) or bus (line 72) from our luxury serviced residence Paris Louvre.

Step into one of our 51 intimate apartments and experience luxury and comfort on a different scale.
Within your apartment, find yourself encompassed by plush furnishings, elegant decor and modern facilities.
Step outside the residence, and you are immediately located in one of Paris’ most upscale and sought after districts.
All our apartments come with high quality bedding, soundproof walls, a fully-equipped kitchen, fine tableware, Nespresso coffee-maker and high speed Wi-Fi.

Looking for Paris beyond the postcard? Welcome to lyf Gambetta Paris, a lifestyle hotel located at 4 rue de la Cour des Noues, in Paris’ 20th arrondissement. This GSTC-certified property occupies a former printing house transformed into an urban residence. It offers rooms, studios and apartments ranging from 16 to 74 m², designed for stays from one night to several months.
Lyf is a brand by The Ascott Limited.

The 20th arrondissement: a neighbourhood to live in, not just visit

lyf Gambetta Paris is located between Père-Lachaise Cemetery, rue des Pyrénées and the Belleville market, one of the largest popular markets in Paris. Gambetta is a residential and lively area of the 20th arrondissement, with neighbourhood bars, independent restaurants and artists’ studios that make local Paris feel alive. Ménilmontant, Belleville and Oberkampf are accessible on foot or within two metro stops, away from tourist flows.

Welcoming spaces built for connections

Set inside a former printing house, the property brings industrial character together with social spaces, Bistouille bar, coworking areas, a sauna, terraces, and a community-minded lyf crew ready to point you towards the best of Gambetta, Belleville, and the city beyond.

Staying at Lyf Gambetta Paris within vibrant social spaces means becoming part of a real community.

FAQs

What is an aparthotel?

Expect the perfect blend of home and hotel from a Staycity aparthotel. This means you have all the freedom, privacy and creature comforts of your own home through the likes of a fully equipped kitchen and spacious dining, living and working spaces, combined with the consistency and convenience of standard hotel services such as 24-hour reception, fresh towels and bed linen, and cleaning.

Is the aparthotel centrally located?

Yes. Whether you’re staying for work, pleasure or both, you’re right in the heart of the action. At Staycity Gare de l’Est, you’re really close to the likes of Gare de l’Est station (0.29km), Gare du Nord station (0.85km), the Picasso National Museum (1.9km) Centre Georges Pompidou (1.7km), the Louvre (2.5km) and Notre Dame Cathedral (2.6km).

Do you provide room cleaning?

Your apartment is yours to enjoy, with all the space and freedom of having your own place in the city. For stays of 1–6 nights, we don't provide a scheduled clean, but you'll have cleaning supplies and fresh towels in your apartment, and you can arrange an additional clean with reception for a small fee. Staying 7 nights or more? We'll give your apartment a full clean on day 4, and every 7 days after that. Need extra towels or supplies? Just ask our reception team – we're always happy to help.

Do you have parking?

Yes, we have a private and secure on-site carpark and you can easily reserve your space when you complete your online booking with us. The cost is €30 per car for 24 hours. You can access it through Passage Dubail via Boulevard de Magenta. On arrival, please come to reception and our friendly team will show you how to access the carpark.

Is the aparthotel close to the Stade de France?

Yes! Our location is really convenient if you are looking to stay close to the Stade de France. Just take the metro to Gare du Nord then take the RER B to the La Plaine-Stade de France stop. The journey will take you 25 minutes door to door!

Do you provide cots and high chairs?

Yes, we provide complimentary cots and high chairs. A fitted sheet is included with the travel cot, but you need to provide the rest. You can add cots and high chairs to your booking on staycity.com so they're in your apartment when you arrive.

Are the sofa beds made up on arrival?

Our specially designed super comfy sofa beds are not made up on arrival, but we provide all the necessary linen required in your room.

Do you offer discounts for longer stays?

Yes! We offer 20% off stays for 7 - 21 nights and 30% off stays for over 21 nights.

Are there environmentally sustainable initiatives at the property?

Yes! We are working towards carbon neutrality and adopting waste management practices across all our properties.

Can I bring my e-bike or e-scooter into the hotel?

No. Due to the fire hazard associated with lithium-ion batteries, e-bikes, e-scooters and their associated lithium-ion batteries are not permitted in any area of the hotel. This includes guest rooms, corridors, car parks and back-of-house areas. This policy applies to all guests, contractors and delivery riders.

Good to Know

Cleaning

As an aparthotel, we want you to enjoy all the freedom, space and flexibility of having your own place to stay. Your apartment is your space to live, relax and settle in, so we leave you to enjoy it your way. We don’t provide daily housekeeping, but you’ll find everything you need to keep things fresh and tidy throughout your stay.
Staying 1–6 nights?
There’s no scheduled clean during your stay. Cleaning supplies, bin bags and fresh towels are provided in your apartment, so you can keep things just the way you like them. If you'd like a full refresh, including fresh linen and towels, our reception team can arrange an additional clean for a small charge.
Staying 7 nights or more?
We’ll carry out a full clean of your apartment on day 4 of your stay, including fresh bed linen and towels, and every 7 days after that.
Need extra towels, supplies or anything else? Our reception team are always happy to help.

House Rules

We have a strict non-smoking policy in any of our rooms or communal areas. Events, parties or additional guests/visitors are not permitted. We also now offer pet friendly stays – check out our pet policy
here
.

Online Check-in

Check-in online before you arrive! Our quick and easy online check-in is required at all our properties so all you have to do is pick up your key on arrival.
Check-in is from 3pm (15:00) and check-out is before 11am (11:00), or 12pm for members (subject to availability).
We offer the flexibility to extend your check-out time by up to 4 hours (or 3 hours if you've opted for 12pm check-out). This is subject to availability, and is charged per hour.

Flexible Cancellation

We know that flexibility is more important than ever for our guests, and we want to give you ultimate peace of mind when you book with us. Fully Flexible rates offer free cancellation online up to 3pm the day before you arrive. If cancelled outside of this the first night will be charged.
No Show Policy
If a customer fails to arrive or does not cancel within the cancellation policy time – they are treated as a “No Show”. If they have booked the fully flexible rate they will be charged for the first night of their stay only. If they have booked a semi-flexible rate the full amount will be charged and is non-refundable.

Are there environmentally sustainable initiatives at the property?

We are also committed to minimising food waste. To support this, we have partnered with HopHopFood to redistribute any surplus food within the local community, ensuring it does not go to waste. We continuously look for ways to enhance our environmental initiatives as part of our ongoing commitment to responsible operations.

How does Staycity reduce energy consumption across its properties?

We use a range of energy-efficient measures to reduce consumption while maintaining guest comfort. Heating is capped at 24°C and air conditioning is set no lower than 18°C to support responsible energy use.

How can guests support Staycity's sustainability efforts?

Simple actions can make a meaningful difference. By switching off lights, heating, air conditioning and electrical equipment when leaving your apartment, you can help reduce unnecessary energy consumption.
We are committed to reducing waste through re-use, recycling and responsible resource management. During your stay, please use the dedicated recycling, food waste and general waste bins provided. By separating your waste correctly, you can help maximise recycling and recovery rates, reduce contamination and support our commitment to keeping valuable resources in circulation.
You'll also find opportunities to refill your water bottle, helping to reduce single-use plastic consumption.
If you'd like to explore the local area more sustainably, our team will be happy to direct you to public transport options, nearby green spaces and walking routes, or help you hire a bike.

How does Staycity reduce water and laundry waste?

To help conserve water, energy and cleaning resources, towels are replaced on request rather than automatically every day. This approach reduces environmental impact while ensuring guest comfort throughout their stay.

Can I request fresh towels during my stay?

Absolutely. If you would like fresh towels at any time, simply contact reception and our team will be happy to arrange this for you.

Will towels be replaced during longer stays?

For longer stays, towels are automatically refreshed every seven days, balancing guest comfort with our commitment to reducing unnecessary water and energy use.

How does Staycity encourage responsible water and energy use in apartments?

Where dishwashers are available, we recommend using the Eco mode. This setting is designed to use less water and energy, helping to reduce the environmental footprint of your stay.

Why are these sustainability measures important?

Our environmental initiatives help reduce energy consumption, conserve water, minimise waste and lower carbon emissions across our properties. By working together with our guests, we can make travel more sustainable and create a positive impact for the communities in which we operate.

Can I bring my e-bike or e-scooter into the hotel?

No. Due to the fire hazard associated with lithium-ion batteries, e-bikes, e-scooters and their associated lithium-ion batteries are not permitted in any area of the hotel. This includes guest rooms, corridors, car parks and back-of-house areas. This policy applies to all guests, contractors and delivery riders.

Good to Know

Cleaning

As an aparthotel, we want you to enjoy all the freedom, space and flexibility of having your own place to stay. Your apartment is your space to live, relax and settle in, so we leave you to enjoy it your way. We don’t provide daily housekeeping, but you’ll find everything you need to keep things fresh and tidy throughout your stay.
Staying 1–6 nights?
There’s no scheduled clean during your stay. Cleaning supplies, bin bags and fresh towels are provided in your apartment, so you can keep things just the way you like them. If you'd like a full refresh, including fresh linen and towels, our reception team can arrange an additional clean for a small charge.
Staying 7 nights or more?
We’ll carry out a full clean of your apartment on day 4 of your stay, including fresh bed linen and towels, and every 7 days after that.
Need extra towels, supplies or anything else? Our reception team are always happy to help.

House Rules

We have a strict non-smoking policy in any of our rooms or communal areas. Events, parties or additional guests/visitors are not permitted. We also now offer pet friendly stays – check out our pet policy
here
.

Online Check-in

Check-in online before you arrive! Our quick and easy online check-in is required at all our properties so all you have to do is pick up your key on arrival.
Check-in is from 3pm (15:00) and check-out is before 11am (11:00), or 12pm for members (subject to availability).
We offer the flexibility to extend your check-out time by up to 4 hours (or 3 hours if you've opted for 12pm check-out). This is subject to availability, and is charged per hour.

Flexible Cancellation

We know that flexibility is more important than ever for our guests, and we want to give you ultimate peace of mind when you book with us. Fully Flexible rates offer free cancellation online up to 3pm the day before you arrive. If cancelled outside of this the first night will be charged.
No Show Policy
If a customer fails to arrive or does not cancel within the cancellation policy time – they are treated as a “No Show”. If they have booked the fully flexible rate they will be charged for the first night of their stay only. If they have booked a semi-flexible rate the full amount will be charged and is non-refundable.

Accessibility

We have accessible rooms available with extra space for wheelchair users and features such as lowered bathroom facilities and pull cord for emergencies.

Le Jardin de Verre by Locke
Latin Quarter | 5th Arrondissement Paris

Two French Baroque mansions and a 19th-century factory, reimagined as one address on Rue de Lacépède. Le Jardin de Verre by Locke holds 145 rooms, studios, suites and apartments across the Latin Quarter — original stonework and old factory ironwork left exposed, new details layered in around them. Most come with their own kitchen, for anyone who'd rather cook than go out.

A triple-height atrium restaurant. A cocktail bar with its own rhythm. A courtyard built for long lunches and later drinks, plus a yoga studio and gym for the mornings after. The Panthéon, Jardin des Plantes and Sorbonne University are all a short walk from the door.

Twelve categories, all with their own kitchen except The Room. Each one is designed for the way you actually live — not just where you sleep.

Small plates under a triple-height atrium. Cocktails that don't rush. A courtyard built for the slow afternoons in between. Bibie and its café and bar sit right at the heart of the hotel — you don't have to leave to find your table.

Two meeting rooms, a suite, and a shared space to work from — set inside a French Baroque mansion. For pitches, launches, or the meeting that turns into dinner.

Le Jardin de Verre by Locke Paris | France 7 Rue Lacepede, 75005 Telephone: +33 1 87 70 63 10 Email: [email protected]

Studio apartments and family suites. An abundance of options for food and drinks. A yoga studio, atrium restaurant and outdoor courtyards. Considered design in a friendly location. Our Paris hotel has it all. On River Seine's left bank is the 5th arondissement, one of the oldest in Paris. Home to ancient cobbled streets, vintage cabaret clubs and one of the capital's earliest monuments, this historic district is a dive into Paris' past.

Students from nearby universities enliven French café culture and sidewalk boutiques. Families flock to the Jardin du Luxembourg and National Museum of Natural History. With Le Jardin de Verre by Locke as your base, it's all yours to discover.

Arrival and departure
How do I check in and check out?
Here's all you need to know about checking in and checking out of our hotels.
What time is check in?
Standard check-in:
Our standard check in time is
3pm
at all Locke hotels. If you're planning to arrive later than 11pm,
please let our property teams know in advance
, as a House Host may need to unlock the main doors for you.
Contact us.
Can I arrive earlier than the standard check-in time?
Start your stay earlier with a
1pm check-in
, available for an additional fee and subject to availability. To secure this, you can add early check-in during the booking stage, or you can add early check-in to your booking for an additional fee (subject to availability) by contacting our reservations team.
Contact us.
I want to check in early on the day of arrival of my booking. How can I do this?
We usually recommend giving at least
48 hours’ notice
to arrange early check-in, so our property team has enough time to prepare your apartment.
Early check-in on the day of arrival is subject to availability. Please contact your Locke property team to see if it can be arranged.
How do I check in and collect my keys?
You'll need to collect your apartment keys from the front desk when you arrive. Our House Hosts will be on hand to welcome you, provide your access key cards (one per person) and any further information you require. If you've
checked in online
before you arrive, your check-in process will be much quicker.
Additionally, some Locke hotels* offers self-check in at kiosks located in reception, where you can sort your own key. You can collect your keys any time after your check-in time (3pm as standard).
*Please note that Eden Locke and Whitworth Locke don't have self-check-in kiosks.
For SACO properties, all access details will be sent via email at 1pm on the day of arrival to the email address provided at the time of reservation. If you haven’t received these details before your arrival, please check your Junk mail folder firs before contacting our property team - details can be found on our contact us page.
What do I need to bring with me to check in when I arrive?
When you arrive, please make sure you bring the following:
Your confirmation email
Official Photo ID*
Payment card or method used for booking
It is also possible to check in online before you arrive, but please still bring the above with you, as they may be required in case of any issues with your booking.
*Please note, only government-issued photo ID is accepted, such as a passport or driving licence. Other forms of ID such as student ID, employer IDs and payment cards are not accepted.
Why do I need to bring ID with me for check in?
It's a legal requirement for us to prove and verify your legal identity when you are staying at one of our aparthotels. This helps to reduce cases of identity fraud and ensures we're checking in the right person. By booking and staying with us, you must also meet minimum requirements, including being over 18 years of age (unless accompanied by a parent or guardian).
Please note that if we are unable to verify your identity, we may have to cancel your booking.
I'll be arriving early or departing late - can reception store my luggage?
We've all been there - you've arrived to the city early, or your travel home is later in the evening, meaning you'll need to carry your bags around all day.
Our on-site teams are happy to store your luggage free of charge during the day if you're arriving earlier than check in time, or want to explore the city after you check out (no later than day of arrival/departure).
What time is check out?
Standard check-out:
Our check-out time for all Locke properties is 11am, and you can leave any time before this.
Can I stay later than the standard check-out time?
If you'd like to snooze a little longer,
late check-out
until 1pm is available for an additional fee, subject to availability. We recommend checking with the property during your stay, or you can book by contacting our reservations team.

Contact our Reservations Team
and a member of the team will get back to you as soon as possible.

Aparthotel Séjours & Affaires Paris Vitry

Location between parks, heritage, family tourism and professional activity zones

The Séjours & Affaires Paris Vitry hotel residence is ideally located, close to the gates of Paris and its cultural heritage, the
Rungis international market
and
Paris-Orly airport
. You will also be close to local shops and restaurants, while benefiting from quick access to
motorways
and bus lines.

Vitry-sur-Seine, a green city, offers privileged spaces for relaxation:
Cormailles departmental park
, Lilas, municipal parks, squares and gardens... and the proximity of the
Bois de Vincennes
.

The city has a varied and remarkable heritage with the massive presence of contemporary works of art in its streets, the
Museum of Contemporary Art of Val-de-Marne (MAC VAL)
, as well as renowned ancient monuments such as the
Saint-Germain church of Vitry-sur-Seine
built in the 12th and 13th centuries.

You can also visit the
Exploradôme
(interactive science and digital museum) with your family and enjoy numerous activities throughout the year: Spring Carnival, the
Lilac Festival
, the
Lilabyrinthe
at Parc des Lilas,
the Oh! Festival
…

The aparthotel

The 80 accommodations are furnished, equipped and include: a living room with a double bed or two twin beds, an LCD television, an office space, a
equipped kitchen
(ceramic hob, refrigerator, microwave and dishes), a bathroom.

Equipment and Services

You will appreciate the equipment and services provided free of charge, such as Wi-Fi Internet access, the reception open all day and all year round, the
fitness room
, the fitness, weekly cleaning or even the bicycle storage.

Several additional services will make your stay easier:
organic breakfast
, parking, laundry, etc.

The highlights of this aparthotel

100% ORGANIC breakfast
Proximity to Paris
Easy access to transport (airport, bus, metro, tram, RER)
Tourist activities in Val-de-Marne

Official apartment pages

My Maison Montmartre Two rooms - Superior Prévert (311, 312, 321, 322, 331, 332, 341, 341)

Come in and make yourself at home in this apartment nestled in the heart of the legendary Cité Véron in Montmartre, a place steeped in history where tranquility reigns, just a stone's throw from the hustle and bustle of Paris. Here, you can experience Paris from the courtyard side, far from the hustle and bustle, in a peaceful and authentic atmosphere.

In the fully equipped kitchen, you will find everything you need to concoct your secret recipes or improvise a Parisian dinner after a day of strolling through the hills of Montmartre.
The living room awaits you for a well-deserved break, a moment of reading, or an inspired work session, bathed in natural light and a soft atmosphere.
Welcome to the bedroom, a cozy and enveloping nest, designed for restful nights in the heart of Paris.

In terms of amenities, we have thought of everything to make your stay simple, comfortable, and uncompromising: practical storage, workspace, Wi-Fi connection, quality bedding, and a functional kitchenette.

And that little extra soul? The subtly integrated retro design, which adds character and a timeless Parisian touch to the whole. Do you like this style that tells a story?

Why "Appartement Prévert"?
The name pays homage to the poet Jacques Prévert, who lived in the same Cité Véron as his friend Boris Vian. Staying here means sleeping in a place steeped in creativity, poetry, and the bohemian spirit of Montmartre, among secret alleyways, artists' studios, and legendary cafés. To reach the Place du Tertre—a meeting place for artists past and present—pass through the Abbesses and the legendary Rue Lepic.

Please note: Windows are fixed. Photos are not contractual. There are different layouts and types of furniture, all equally pleasant, which will be allocated to you according to availability.

My Maison Montmartre Two rooms - Deluxe (121, 122, 131, 132, 141, 142)

Here, Paris puts on a show. From the window, the street comes alive, the lights of the Moulin Rouge twinkle just a stone's throw away, and the atmosphere of Montmartre experienced live, without filters.

Start by looking up: this two-room apartment offers a beautiful view of the neighborhood, bathed in light and Parisian energy. It's the perfect vantage point to feel the heartbeat of the 18th arrondissement, just a two-minute walk (top chrono) from Place de Clichy.

Then head to the kitchen, designed for spontaneous cravings and morning rituals alike. You'll find everything you need to prepare your secret recipes, a quick coffee before setting off to explore Paris, or a quiet dinner after a busy day.

The living room invites you to slow down. It's a place to relax, read a few pages, or work in an atmosphere that is both lively and cozy.
When it comes to amenities, nothing has been left to chance: comfort, practicality, and functionality are all there for a stress-free stay.

And what's that little twist that makes all the difference? The design, inspired by current trends, which brings character and real personality to the space. You either like it or love it—but you won't forget it.

Please note: The photos are not contractual, there are different layouts and types of furniture, all equally pleasant, which will be allocated to you according to availability.

My Maison Montmartre - One Bedroom - Classic (301)

Come in and make yourself at home in this Montmartre haven of peace. The room feels like a cozy, enveloping little box.

The lounge awaits you for a well-deserved break or an inspired work session.

In the kitchen, you'll find everything you need to make your secret recipes.

The shower room has a large open shower cubicle and WC.

And when it comes to storage and equipment, we've thought of everything.

.

My Maison in Paris
Sentier
6 rue Saint-Spire, 75002 Paris Bobo Sentier .
Located in the heart of Paris, the Sentier district has had 1,000 lives! It was home to the famous "Court of Miracles" in the Middle Ages, then to the press, the stock exchange and textile wholesalers. Today, it's home to so many start-ups that it's been dubbed the "Silicon Sentier ". Nestled on a lovely pedestrian square, absolute calm and charm come together for our first home, just a stone's throw from Paris, the capital of fashion and energy.
